method.cross_check:
import hashlib,json,random,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
w=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
repo=Path.cwd().resolve(); t=repo/'tide'; out=repo/'experimente/23_native_division'
w.mkdir(exist_ok=True); shutil.copyfile(repo/'tide.lock', w/'tide.lock')
def run(cmd): return subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
def simple(p):
    if p.returncode==0:
        assert not p.stderr
        assert p.stdout==str(int(p.stdout))+'\n'
        return p.stdout.strip()
    assert p.returncode==1 and not p.stdout and p.stderr.endswith('\n'),(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
    e=json.loads(p.stderr); return e['code']+('/'+e['reason'] if 'reason' in e else '')
def reference(src,fn=None,inputs=None):
    cmd=[t,'run',src]
    if fn: cmd+=['--call',fn]
    if inputs is not None: cmd+=['--inputs',json.dumps(inputs,separators=(',',':'))]
    return simple(run(cmd))
def build(src,exe,entry=None):
    run([t,'check',src]).check_returncode()
    cmd=[t,'run',repo/'native/fold_i64.tide','--read','source='+str(src)]
    if entry: cmd+=['--call','compile_entry','--inputs',json.dumps({'entry':entry})]
    p=run(cmd); assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
    exe.write_bytes(bytes.fromhex(json.loads(p.stdout)));exe.chmod(0o700)
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
result={'fixtures':[], 'operands':[], 'cartons':[]}
f=run([t,'run',out/'faelle.tide']); f.check_returncode()
for c in json.loads(f.stdout):
    p=run([t,'run',repo/'experimente/20_native_ausdruecke/faelle.tide','--call','native_case','--inputs',json.dumps(c)])
    p.check_returncode(); trial=json.loads(p.stdout)
    src=w/'case.tide'; src.write_text(trial['source'])
    n,*items=c['items'].split(); assert len(items)==int(n)
    args=[c['initial']]+items
    expected='E_DATA/division_by_zero' if c['expected']=='E_DATA' else c['expected']
    assert reference(src)==expected,(c,reference(src),expected)
    entry=w/'case-call'; fixed=w/'case-fixed'
    build(src,fixed); build(src,entry,'apply')
    assert simple(run([fixed]))==simple(run([entry,*args]))==expected,c
    result['fixtures'].append(dict(name=c['name'],result=expected,closed_sha=sha(fixed),dynamic_sha=sha(entry)))
MIN=-(1<<63); MAX=(1<<63)-1
bounds=[MIN,MIN+1,-23,-7,-2,-1,0,1,2,7,23,MAX-1,MAX]
rng=random.Random(23023); samples=set()
while len(samples)<128:
    a=rng.randrange(MIN,MAX+1)
    b=rng.choice(bounds) if rng.randrange(2)==0 else rng.randrange(MIN,MAX+1)
    if a not in bounds: samples.add((a,b))
pairs=[(a,b) for a in bounds for b in bounds]+sorted(samples)
for op in ('div','mod'):
    src=w/(op+'.tide'); src.write_text('main seed:i xs:*i > i\nfold xs seed acc row x '+op+' acc x\n')
    exe=w/('test-'+op);build(src,exe)
    for a,b in pairs:
        val=reference(src,inputs={'seed':a,'xs':[b]})
        native=simple(run([exe,str(a),str(b)]))
        if b==0: math_value='E_DATA/division_by_zero'
        else:
            q=(abs(a)//abs(b))*(-1 if (a<0)!=(b<0) else 1)
            x=q if op=='div' else a-q*b
            math_value=str(x) if MIN<=x<=MAX else 'E_OVERFLOW'
        assert native==val==math_value,(op,a,b,native,val,math_value)
        result['operands'].append(dict(op=op,a=str(a),b=str(b),result=val))
src=w/'cartons.tide'; shutil.copyfile(repo/'apps/cartons.tide',src)
exe=w/'cartons'; build(src,exe,'carton_balance'); fixed=w/'cartons-closed'; build(src,fixed)
assert simple(run([fixed]))==reference(src)=='2'
for line in src.read_text().splitlines():
    if not line.startswith('{"inputs"'): continue
    record=json.loads(line); inputs=record['inputs']
    expected=record['expect_error']['code'] if 'expect_error' in record else str(record['expect'])
    args=[str(inputs['opening']),*map(str,inputs['pieces'])]
    assert expected==reference(src,'carton_balance',inputs)==simple(run([exe,*args]))==simple(run([sys.executable,'-BS',w/'comparator.py',*args]))
    result['cartons'].append(dict(inputs=inputs,result=expected))
result['images']={'fixed':sha(fixed),'dynamic':sha(exe)}
result['budget']=[]
for fn in ['quotient','remainder']:
    fixture=out/'budget.tide'; bounded=w/('budget-'+fn); build(fixture,bounded,fn)
    for total in [100000,100001]:
        ticks=total-3
        h=next(h for h in range(ticks//27,0,-1) if (ticks-27*h)%7==0)
        cheap=(ticks-27*h)//7
        for last in [0,-1]:
            xs=[9]*cheap+[1]*(h-1)+[last]
            expected='E_LIMIT' if total>100000 else ('E_DATA/division_by_zero' if last==0 else ('0' if fn=='remainder' else 'E_OVERFLOW'))
            actual=simple(run([bounded,str(MIN),*map(str,xs)]))
            r=reference(fixture,fn,{'opening':MIN,'values':xs})
            assert actual==r==expected,(fn,total,cheap,h,last,actual,r,expected)
            result['budget'].append(dict(function=fn,steps=total,seed=str(MIN),nines=cheap,ones=h-1,last=last,result=actual))
(w/'checked.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('passed',len(pairs),'pairs per operation,',len(result['fixtures']),'nested scenarios,',len(result['cartons']),'application examples')
method.allocation:
import hashlib,json,sys
from contextlib import ExitStack
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.cwd().resolve();sys.path.insert(0,str(repo))
from tide_lang.cli import bindings
from tide_lang.core import Error
from tide_lang.program import compile_source
from tide_lang.runtime import Run
from tide_lang.workbench import project
w=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
measurements=[]
for variant in ('before','after'):
    src,mods=project(repo/'native/fold_i64.tide')
    if variant=='before': mods['scalar.tide']=(w/'scalar-before.tide').read_text()
    defs,_=compile_source(src,mods); d=defs['compile_entry']
    for path,entry in [('apps/cartons.tide','carton_balance'),('experimente/23_native_division/budget.tide','quotient'),('experimente/23_native_division/budget.tide','remainder'),('apps/heating.tide','degree_hours')]:
        runtime=Run(defs); initial=runtime.memory; work=runtime.remaining
        with ExitStack() as grants:
            args=bindings(d,json.dumps({'entry':entry}),['source='+path],grants)
            try:
                image=bytes.fromhex(runtime.eval(d.body,args))
                result={'bytes':len(image),'image_sha256':hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest()}
            except Error as e:
                result={'error':e.code,'message':str(e)}
        measurements.append(dict(variant=variant,path=path,entry=entry,logical_bytes_charged=initial-runtime.memory,logical_bytes_limit=initial,steps_used=work-runtime.remaining,result=result))
(w/'allocation.json').write_text(json.dumps(measurements,indent=2)+'\n')
for r in measurements:
 print(r['variant'],r['entry'],r['logical_bytes_charged'],r['result'].get('error','OK'))
